description: A sale's payer details: who pays part of it, the claim, the shares line by line and the payer journal. One per payer sale, payer return and Desk payer invoice, linked from that sale; written only by the payer door, never by hand.

fields.description: The sale's name (text, not a link: a link would refuse deleting a draft invoice or a cancelled sale).
fields.label: Sale

fields.description: The sale's company: a User Permission on Company narrows who may read this record, as it does the sale.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: The journal that moved the payer's share to the payer's account.
fields.label: Payer Journal

fields.description: The payer service that answered for this sale. Its name, not a link: a sale outlives an uninstalled service.
fields.label: Payer Service

fields.description: The account the payer's share passed through.
fields.label: Payer Clearing Account

fields.description: The role that may bill a rejected claim back to the customer.
fields.label: Bill-Back Role

fields.description: The customer record of the payer that pays part of this sale. Its share is owed by it.
fields.label: Payer

fields.description: The payer's name as its service gave it.
fields.label: Payer Name

fields.description: The payer's code in its service.
fields.label: Payer Code

fields.description: The customer's plan with the payer.
fields.label: Plan

fields.description: The service's own reference for the customer's cover.
fields.label: Member Reference

fields.description: The member number, masked to its last four digits.
fields.label: Member

fields.description: The payer's claim for this sale.
fields.label: Claim Reference

fields.description: The payer's share of this sale, owed by the payer.
fields.label: Billed to Payer

fields.description: The customer's own share of this sale.
fields.label: Paid by Customer

fields.description: On: the payer takes this sale back only whole.
fields.label: Returned Whole Only

fields.description: On a return of a payer sale: the payer's share of the returned lines, given back to the payer.
fields.label: Payer Share Given Back

fields.description: On a return: the part of the share given back that had been billed back to the customer, so it is settled on the customer's own invoice.
fields.label: Of It, Billed Back Earlier

fields.description: The prescription details sent to the payer, if any.
fields.label: Prescription Reference

fields.description: The prescriber sent to the payer, if any.
fields.label: Prescriber

fields.description: The prescriber's licence sent to the payer, if any.
fields.label: Prescriber Licence

fields.description: The payer's answer as booked. Never changed.
fields.label: Payer Answer

fields.description: The payer's answer as the site sealed it at Ask the payer; the submit books from it and nothing else.
fields.label: Payer Answer (Sealed)

lede: An insurer's (payer's) part of one sale: who pays it, the claim, the shares line by line and the payer journal. One per payer sale, payer return and back-office payer invoice, linked from that sale; written only by the payer door, read by a System Manager.
name: Retail Payer Record

fields.description: The sale line's position (its idx).
fields.label: Sale line

fields.description: This line's payer share, as the payer answered.
fields.label: Billed to Payer

fields.description: This line's customer share.
fields.label: Paid by Customer

fields.description: How much of this line the payer covered.
fields.label: Payer Covered Qty

fields.description: The GTIN sent to the payer for this line.
fields.label: Payer GTIN

fields.description: On a return: this line's payer share given back, in proportion to the quantity returned.
fields.label: Payer Share Given Back

why: contract payer; recipe third_party_payer; sample S43
